$comment: Refusal registry (spec 55 §2): a corpus entry may end refused only with a reason listed here. `match` is a substring of the kernel's text; each refusal is a decision of the named spec or module, not a bug left open.

refusals.match: only a full revolution (360 degrees) can be shelled
refusals.note: the exact shell of a revolution needs its closed profile; a partial revolve has end caps the offset does not carry yet

refusals.match: a sweep of several separate profiles has no exact model yet
refusals.note: one exact sweep per profile group

refusals.match: a hole on the work plane
refusals.note: holes on a work plane that does not resolve to a frame

refusals.match: a text on the work plane
refusals.note: texts on a work plane that does not resolve to a frame

refusals.match: an ellipsoid has no exact model yet
refusals.note: the kernel has no rational ellipsoid surface

refusals.match: an involute gear has no exact model yet
refusals.note: involute flanks are not among the kernel's exact curves
the exact replay stopped at its deadline; the entry is also over its own budget
